title: MarketplaceChannelWentStale v1 payload
description: A marketplace binding has had at least one dish unconfirmed for longer than its bound (marketplace.availability.stale_after_seconds, ADR 0030): the platform believes one thing about the stop list and has not been able to make the partner agree (ADR 0040, ADR 0141). Published once per episode; the binding is not reported again until it has had nothing unconfirmed past its bound and then goes stale again. Counts, identifiers and instants only: no dish name, no partner error text, no personal data (ADR 0029).
